change_summary: Replaced FP32 scalar tl.dot (allow_tf32=False) with FP16 Tensor Core path (cast a,b to tl.float16 before tl.dot, acc stays FP32) to engage Hopper Tensor Cores while meeting atol=1e-3; added 4 larger BLOCK_K (128/256) configs with num_stages=4/5 for better pipelining. FP8 was rejected because E4M3's 3-bit mantissa accumulates ~70 error over K=4096 steps.
